objective: Test whether segment-grouped masked frozen-NT reconstruction learns more reusable representations than a matched random encoder, and whether graph messages add beyond the coordinate stream.
name: GraphMAE-style objective adaptation on the native PangenomeFM backbone
input_policy: Native 7 structural features with component ID removed, plus the complete frozen 512D NT cache. Same raw values and coordinate/orientation covariates as the Q branch. Frozen NT is never trained.
window_policy: Exactly the one-hop junction-matched eligible windows under split_seed=20260806, separated by original chromosome folds. Test windows are never loaded. No biological labels in pretraining.
masking: All 519 input columns replaced by a learned token for a sampled set of biological segment IDs; both oriented handles always hidden together. No random feature replacement. Fresh deterministic mask per training epoch/window; three fixed validation masks.
target_policy: 512D frozen NT vector standardized with moments from unique training segments only. This explicit adaptation avoids a constant mean direction dominating raw NT cosine reconstruction. No coordinate reconstruction.
decoder: 48D linear projection, zero all masked latent rows, one native bidirectional graph-attention layer and a 512D linear output. No latent residual/copy; full structural graph retained, no edge prediction loss.
loss: Scaled cosine error alpha=2, equal weight per biological segment within a window; training averages windows. Validation weights masked segment counts across the fixed window/mask bank.
selection: Minimum self-supervised validation reconstruction loss only. Random encoder receives identical initialization and decoder optimization; its encoder weights must remain bitwise unchanged.
downstream: Frozen cCRE and historical INS/DEL probes on fold-A validation only, native C+S / C+S+E / C+S+H / C+S+H+E, same manuscript extraction universe, uniform max_iter=4000. No test scoring or checkpoint selection using these labels.
decision: Retain all arms and seeds irrespective of performance. Require converged, identical-example probes and positive trained-minus-random AP after H on both tasks in all three seeds before proposing chromosome replication. Do not infer CI from initialization seeds.
validity_gates: Checkpoint reload reproduces selected reconstruction score
Downstream target and baseline score identities match
limitations: Exploratory follow-up after failed junction development gates; these remain recorded
Native backbone, grouped masks and standardized targets differ from official GraphMAE
Coordinate covariates remain visible; coordinate-only control required
One development fold cannot establish chromosome generalization
Equal nominal epoch budget does not imply compute equivalence to junction training
No automated promotion or claim of NMI acceptance
